coverage: Named roster: FETCHED at the primary — CSD G15 (raw wikitext and rendered); the two August 2025 G15 RfCs in Wikipedia talk:Speedy deletion/Archive 92 (with the correction that the CREATING RfC was July 2025 and the August ones both FAILED); WP:Signs of AI writing; the French Observatoire des IA project, its Contrôle procedure page and its 9 May 2026 report; the German Wikipedia:Anzeichen für KI-generierte Inhalte; Triedman & Mantzarlis's Cornell Tech Grokipedia paper and Yasseri's Grokipedia comparison; Herbold et al. (via the arXiv preprint, since nature.com serves a paywall stub); Guo et al. HC3; Jentzsch & Kersting; Naous et al.; Mohammadi; Yakura et al.; Chambers & Kelley (Crossref DOI 10.1007/978-3-031-98420-4_7 confirmed authors, venue and pages, full text read at arXiv HTML). NOT FOUND AS NAMED: a Pangram Labs-authored 2025 analysis of AI text on Wikipedia — the Pangram-based Wikipedia audit that exists is Wiki Education's, published 29 January 2026, and it is read here at the primary. BLOCKED and recovered: openreview.net returned HTTP 403 for Huang et al. (recovered at arXiv), science.org returned a stub for Kobak et al. (recovered at PubMed Central), nature.com paywalled Herbold (recovered at arXiv); Mohammadi's PDF has unextractable digit glyphs, so no numeric figure is claimed from it. Substantive sources per route: 8 from the named roster fetched directly, 6 from bibliography chasing inside those pages' own citations (Reinhart, Kobak, Brooks, Russell, Yasseri, Wiki Education), 5 from lateral and archive searches (the two August 2025 RfCs, the WP:AI RfC log, the G15 update proposal, the French report). 23 substantive sources, 84 claims. The angle's stated gap is now filled: five sources measured the ENCYCLOPEDIC or ARCHIVAL register directly (Huang et al. TMLR 2026, Brooks et al. 2024, Yasseri 2025, Triedman & Mantzarlis 2025, Wiki Education/Pangram 2026), and Reinhart et al. supplies the mechanism — the tells are produced by instruction tuning, since Llama base models sit closer to human rates than their Instruct variants.
